fix.notes: The `bannercss()` route at `/banner/banner.css` is intentionally kept for backwards-compat; a future cleanup could remove it. The 101-rule cap (season 0–100) is well beyond the current season count; if the game reaches season 101 a trivial one-line addition is needed. No test existed for the CSS content of the banner route and none was added since the touched files are static assets.
fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

Every page load issued a separate HTTP request for `/banner/banner.css`, a dynamically generated stylesheet that produced one `header.season-N::before { background-image: url("/banner/N.png"); }` rule per known season. This extra round-trip was unnecessary because `pd.css` is already served, cached, and gzip-compressed.

## What changed

- **`shared_web/static/css/pd.css`**: Added 101 static CSS rules covering `header.season-0::before` through `header.season-100::before`, each setting the correct `background-image` URL. This is only ~3 KB uncompressed and compresses well with gzip alongside the rest of `pd.css`.
- **`decksite/templates/header.mustache`**: Removed the `<link rel="stylesheet" href="/banner/banner.css">` tag, eliminating the extra HTTP request on every page load.

The `bannercss()` route in `decksite/controllers/banners.py` is left in place for backwards compatibility (e.g. bookmarks or cached pages), but it no longer needs to be consulted by the main site.

## How it was validated

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed (no Python files changed; CSS/Mustache linting clean)
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit` — 848 passed, 1 skipped in 18.80s

Fixes #11082
fix.pr_title: Inline banner CSS into pd.css, remove dynamic /banner/banner.css request (#11082)

evidence.detail: bannercss() still dynamically generates CSS at runtime by iterating seasons.SEASONS, returning it as a Flask Response — separate HTTP call on every page load
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/banner/banner.css"> is present in every page header, confirming the separate request is still made
No season-N::before background-image rules present — banner CSS is not in the main stylesheet

triage.fix_sketch: Add 101 static CSS rules (header.season-0::before through header.season-100::before with background-image: url('/banner/N.png')) to shared_web/static/css/pd.css; remove the <link> tag from decksite/templates/header.mustache:8; optionally remove or keep the bannercss() route in decksite/controllers/banners.py for backwards-compat. No build tooling change is needed — pd.css is already served and gzipped.
triage.notes: silasary suggested SCSS @for as an alternative; the static-CSS approach avoids adding a preprocessor. The route bannercss() generates only 30-40 rules today; extending to 100 is forward-safe and tiny when gzipped.
